participant_id.Description: BIDS label = the patient code used in the release (HUP### / CHOP###, public pseudonyms of the source)

Levels.HUP: Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania

sex.Description: Sex as released (HUP: metadata-4.csv code 1 = M, 2 = F, mapping from the authors' code/metadata_notebook.ipynb; CHOP: CHOP_metadata.csv)

age.Description: CHOP only: 'precise age at time of recording (y)' from CHOP_metadata.csv, rounded to 0.1 y. Not released for HUP patients.

stim_seizure.Description: stim_sz column of the release: 1 = a stimulation-induced seizure was recorded

mtle.Description: CHOP only: mtle column as released

localization.Description: HUP only: localization column as released (MTLE, LTLE, Other, Diffuse, combinations)

lesional_code.Description: lesional column as released (HUP: 0/1/2, coding not stated in the release; CHOP: 0/1)

implant_code.Description: HUP only: Implant column as released (coding not stated in the release)

outcome.Description: outcome column as released (coding not stated in the release; empty = n/a)

age_at_onset.Description: Age at epilepsy onset as released

epilepsy_duration.Description: Duration of epilepsy as released (HUP 'duration'; CHOP 'duration of epilepsy prior to stim (y)', rounded to 0.01)

n_seizures_annotated.Description: Rows for this patient in stim_seizure_information_BIDS.csv (see sub-*/ieeg/*_seizures.tsv)

n_seizures_model.Description: Rows for this patient in the optimized LSTM model annotation table (see sub-*/ieeg/*_seizures.tsv)
